title: Library events this week
body:
## Green Street Library — Free events this week

**Monday, 4:00 p.m. — Story Time.** For children from 3 to 6. Parents stay with their children.

**Wednesday, 6:30 p.m. — English Conversation Club.** Practice your English with friendly people. All levels are welcome. There's free coffee and tea!

**Friday, 7:00 p.m. — Movie Night.** This week: a comedy. Bring a friend! Please don't bring food or drinks into the room.

**Saturday, 10:00 a.m. — Computer Help.** Bring your laptop or phone. Our volunteers can help you with email and apps.

The library is on Green Street, between the post office and the bank. It's open Monday to Saturday, from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. It's closed on Sundays.
